segments.text: हेलो कैसी हो अच्छी बात कैसे हो बहुत बढ़िया
segments.en: Hello, how are you? Good, how are you? Very good.

segments.en: Sangam Vihar. Sangam Vihar? Okay, where is this?

segments.en: By the way, I am Mayur too. Connected on Instagram? Yes, I will, but I [unclear] you

segments.text: जानू के पहले नहीं मयूर विहार सिंह जानते हो तुम
segments.en: Before knowing, no. Do you know Mayur Vihar?
